cards.name: Sever Soul
cards.oracleText: Destroy target nonblack creature. It can't be regenerated. You gain life equal to its toughness.

cards.name: Sever the Bloodline
cards.oracleText:
Exile target creature and all other creatures with the same name as that creature.
Flashback {5}{B}{B} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

cards.name: Severed Strands
cards.oracleText:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.
You gain life equal to the sacrificed creature's toughness. Destroy target creature an opponent controls.

cards.name: Severed Legion
cards.oracleText: Fear (This creature can't be blocked except by artifact creatures and/or black creatures.)

cards.name: Seven-Tail Mentor
cards.oracleText: When this creature enters or dies, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature or Vehicle you control.

cards.name: Seven Dwarves
cards.oracleText:
This creature gets +1/+1 for each other creature named Seven Dwarves you control.
A deck can have up to seven cards named Seven Dwarves.

cards.name: Severance Priest
cards.oracleText:
Deathtouch
When this creature enters, target opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a nonland card from it. If you do, exile that card.
When this creature leaves the battlefield, the exiled card's owner creates an X/X white Spirit creature token, where X is the mana value of the exiled card.

cards.name: Seventh Stage of Magic Design
cards.oracleText: Double all your spells and abilities. (All spells and abilities cast, activated, or triggered by you are copied. Mana abilities produce twice as much mana.)
